meta.name: game-godot-specialist
meta.description: Invoke when the user works with Godot Engine or asks about GDScript, scene composition, signals, resources, shaders, GDExtension, physics, or Godot UI. Triggers on: "Godot", "GDScript", "scene tree", "signals", ".tscn", ".tres", "GDExtension", "project.godot". Do NOT invoke for engine-agnostic architecture (use game-technical-director) or Unity/Unreal questions (use the appropriate engine specialist). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 Godot 引擎开发 2D/3D 游戏
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Godot 引擎做游戏开发或调试
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing or debugging games with Godot Engine

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成 Godot 4 引擎专家，帮你写带静态类型的 GDScript 代码、设计场景结构、使用信号和资源，并给出可运行的示例。
howto.when: 当你提到“Godot”、“GDScript”、“场景树”、“信号”、“.tscn”、“.tres”、“GDExtension”等关键词，或询问 Godot 引擎相关问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个带静态类型的玩家移动脚本。
say.note: Claude 会生成带类型注解的 GDScript 代码。

say.text: 如何用信号实现跨场景通信？
say.note: Claude 会解释 EventBus 模式并给出示例。

say.text: 优化我的 Godot 项目，避免反模式。
say.note: Claude 会检查代码并给出改进建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a Godot 4 engine specialist. It writes statically typed GDScript, designs scene composition, uses signals and resources, and provides runnable examples.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "Godot", "GDScript", "scene tree", "signals", ".tscn", ".tres", "GDExtension", or ask about Godot engine topics.

say_en.text: Write a statically typed player movement script.
How to communicate across scenes using signals?
say_en.note: Claude explains EventBus pattern with example.

say_en.text: Optimize my Godot project to avoid anti-patterns.
say_en.note: Claude reviews code and suggests improvements.
